analysis.reason: RSI 과매수 구간에서 하락하며 중립 구간 안착 시도 중. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 추세 전환을 확신하기엔 미미한 수준. 5일 고가 갱신 실패로 상승 모멘텀 약화. 거래량 급증은 변동성 확대 가능성 시사. 따라서 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI is declining from overbought territory, attempting to settle in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but is marginal to confirm a trend reversal. Failure to update the 5-day high indicates weakening upward momentum. Increased volume suggests potential for expanded volatility. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($57.50) vs SMA5 ($57.59)/SMA20 ($56.11)/SMA50 ($55.87): below short-term, above mid-term
· SMA100 ($55.97)/SMA200 ($53.50) relative position: strong mid-to-long term trend
· 52-week position (79.5%) + current price range near historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (63.2→57.8): cooling from overbought, entering neutral zone
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.2335→0.2809): improving but insufficient to confirm trend reversal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $56.11): trading around the mid-band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($56.91): pivot-based support
· Swing resistance ($58.41): near 5-day high, potential for upward momentum upon breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low maintained, failed to update 5-day high): weakening upward momentum
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.84x 5-day average): movement gaining traction, potential for increased volatility
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): directional exploration phase, meeting conditions for observation
analysis.patternNote: Higher Low 패턴은 유지하나 5일 고가 갱신에 실패하며 상승 동력 약화. 볼린저밴드 중단 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 탐색 중.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The Higher Low pattern is maintained, but failure to update the 5-day high weakens upward momentum. Trading sideways around the Bollinger Band mid-band, exploring direction.
keyPoints: RSI 과매수 구간에서 하락하며 중립 구간 안착 시도 중.
MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 미미하나 긍정적 신호.
5일 고가 갱신 실패로 상승 모멘텀 약화, 56.91 지지선 확인 필요.
keyPointsEn: RSI declining from overbought, attempting to settle in neutral zone.
MACD histogram improvement is marginal but a positive sign.
Weakening upward momentum due to failure to update 5-day high, 56.91 support level needs confirmation.
analysis.riskNote: 거래량 급증과 함께 5일 고가 갱신 실패는 상승 추세 지속에 대한 의구심을 증폭시키는 요인.

analysis.continuity: 직전 4거래일 연속 매수 판독 유지 후, 금일 RSI 과매수 냉각 및 5일 고가 갱신 실패로 관망 전환. MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 긍정적이나 추세 전환 확신 부족.
analysis.continuityEn: After maintaining a buy signal for the previous 4 sessions, shifted to a wait-and-see stance today due to RSI cooling from overbought and failure to update the 5-day high. MACD histogram improvement is positive but lacks conviction for a trend reversal.
